Message.Name: Timestamp Seconds Message
Message.Description: Reflects the number of seconds past midnight.

Field.Name: Timestamp Seconds
Field.Description: Number of seconds since midnight.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages signal data feed, system and market events.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier. Blank if system wide event.

Field.Name: System Event
Field.Description: System event code.

Message.Name: Price Tick Size Message
Message.Description: The Price Tick Size Message is used to communicate tick size information for a given price range.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Price Tick Size Table Id
Field.Description: Price tick size table identifier.

Field.Name: Price Tick Size
Field.Description: Price tick size.

Field.Name: Price Start
Field.Description: Start of price range for this price tick size.

Message.Name: Orderbook Directory Message
Message.Description: The Orderbook Directory Message is used to disseminate orderbook information for all active orderbooks.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: Orderbook Code
Field.Description: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN).

Field.Name: Exchange Symbol
Field.Description: Exchange Symbol.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Number of shares that represent a round lot.

Field.Name: Price Tick Size Table Id
Field.Description: Price tick size table identifier.

Field.Name: Price Decimals
Field.Description: Number of decimal places in price fields. Value is 2.

Field.Name: Upper Price Limit
Field.Description: Maximum tradable price.

Field.Name: Lower Price Limit
Field.Description: Minimum tradable price.

Field.Name: Restriction of Market Order
Field.Description: Restriction of Market Order.

Field.Name: Attention Flag
Field.Description: Security under supervision.

Field.Name: Termination Flag
Field.Description: Security to be delisted.

Message.Name: Trading State Message
Message.Description: The Trading State Message is used to indicate the current trading state of an orderbook.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: Current trading state.

Message.Name: Order Added Message
Message.Description: An Order Added Message is generated each time a new order is accepted by the ODX PTS execution system.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: Reference number of the accepted order. Zero indicates reference price message.

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Side of the order. Ignore if reference price message.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of shares added to the book. Ignore if reference price message.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order. 7FFFFFFF hex = market order. Reference Price if zero in Order Number.

Message.Name: Order Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: An Order Executed with Price Message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part with a specific trade price.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: Reference number of the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Reference number of the match.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Trade Price.

Field.Name: Occurred as Cross
Field.Description: Y = trade occurred at the cross.

Message.Name: Order Deleted Message
Message.Description: An Order Deleted Message is sent whenever an order on the book is cancelled.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Order Number
Field.Description: Reference number of the cancelled order.

Message.Name: Order Replaced Message
Message.Description: An Order Replaced Message is sent whenever an order on the book is replaced.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Original Order Number
Field.Description: Reference number of the original order.

Field.Name: New Order Number
Field.Description: Reference number of the replaced order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: New total number of shares displayed in the book.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New price of the order. 7FFFFFFF hex = market order.

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: The Order Book State Message is used to communicate the state of an orderbook.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: State Name
Field.Description: Name of Orderbook State.

Message.Name: Equilibrium Price Update Message
Message.Description: The Equilibrium Price Update Message is used to communicate the equilibrium price of an orderbook during an auction period.

Field.Name: Timestamp Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Equilibrium Price. 7FFFFFFF hex = no price available.
